text.aria-label: Title text 'Lags and the output offset each lower the error, and lags plus the offset lower it most Horizontal axis: CRPS minus M0's, in points of capacity (more negative is better). Dot: estimate (2 seeds). Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months (E2: Bonferroni, 24 tests; others uncorrected). Dashed line: same as M0 (no lags, no offset). Experiment 565's coarse M0 and D5 are the M0 and E2 arms.'
text.tspan: Lags and the output offset each lower the error, and lags plus the offset lower it most

Horizontal axis: CRPS minus M0's, in points of capacity (more negative is better). Dot: estimate (2 seeds). Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months (E2: Bonferroni, 24 tests; others uncorrected).
Dashed line: same as M0 (no lags, no offset). Experiment 565's coarse M0 and D5 are the M0 and E2 arms.
